title: 15-Layer Offset Symmetry
concepts: Three remarkable properties: reversal symmetry, single fixed point, every nonzero state occurs twice
Not a topological proof of Möbius strip, but mathematically precise discrete analogue
key_results: Reversal symmetry: sequence reverses onto itself (o_i = o_{14-i})
Single fixed point at center: o_7 = 0
Every nonzero state (1-7) occurs exactly twice
Sum = 56 = 7×8, with zero net modular displacement (56 ≡ 0 mod 8)
This is a mathematically precise discrete analogue of Möbius reversal/closure
